feeds.title: SFN Botanical Art Blog
feeds.description: Ideas, Paintings and Drawings about botanical art. Susan Frei Nathan Fine Works on Paper was established to affirm and promote the place of botanical painting and drawing within the fine art market.

feeds.title: Anna Mason Art Blog
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on botanical paintings. Anna Mason is a watercolor painter and tutor. Her inspiration comes from nature, sunshine and color. She is dedicated to creating resources to help you begin painting or to take your painting to the next level.

feeds.title: Lizzie Harper Blog
feeds.description: Covers nature, botany, botanical illustration, natural history illustration, and illustration techniques. Lizzie Harper is a freelance natural history & botanical illustrator.

feeds.title: Sandrine Maugy Blog
feeds.description: We cover a range of topics, including Illustrations on Botany, Bird, garden, nature, autumn, and much more. Sandrine Maugy has been teaching Botanical Painting for the illustrious West Dean College since 2005.

feeds.title: Dianne Sutherland
feeds.description: A blog about botanical art, including drawing and watercolor painting tuition on paper and vellum. Dianne Sutherland is a Botanical artist and a tutor based in Staffordshire.

feeds.title: Association of Botanical Artists
feeds.description: An association for aspiring botanical artists with a love of native plants. The Association of British Botanical Artists (ABBA) grew out of a plan by the American Society of Botanical Artists (ASBA) to develop a world-wide botanical art exhibition.
